charged.1: Drains Stamina over time to perform continuous slashes.
charged.2: At the end of the sequence, performs a more powerful slash.

plunging.1: Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

description.0: Swings her chain and anchor to deal AoE Electro DMG to nearby opponents and summon a Storm Anchor, an indispensable tool for any maid.
description.1: The Storm Anchor follows your own active character and assists in combat in different ways depending on whether or not Danica is on the field. If Danica is:
2: Off field: The Storm Anchor performs a coordinated attack that deals AoE Electro DMG when your active character's Electro or Cryo attacks hit an opponent. This effect can be triggered once every 1.5s;
On field: Danica uses the Storm Anchor for her Normal Attacks, dealing Electro DMG that cannot be overridden by any other elemental infusion. She cannot perform Charged or Plunging Attacks.
description.4: Additionally, Danica can accumulate the special resource Will to Cleanse while the Storm Anchor is present. She gains this resource when another active character in your party hits an opponent with an Electro or Cryo attack, or when her own Normal Attacks using the Storm Anchor hit an opponent.
description.5: Once Will to Cleanse reaches its maximum, Danica can consume all her Will to Cleanse to use a special Elemental Skill based on whether or not she is on the field. If Danica is:
6: Off field: Switching to Danica unleashes the special Elemental Skill Will to Protect, creating a Royal Aegis and causing her to enter Maid: Royal Guard form;
On field: Danica can use the special Elemental Skill Will to Purge and enter Maid: Cleaner form.

3: The first and fifth attacks deal additional <electro>AoE Electro DMG</electro> that is considered Stellar-Conduct reaction DMG;
For 20s after using her Elemental Burst, Danica also gains additional enhancements while in an Attendant Form, depending on the form she is in. If Danica is in:

description.0: The Storm Anchor also reduces nearby opponents' Electro RES by 15%.
description.1: Radiance: Stellar-Conduct: Opponents near the Storm Anchor have their Electro RES reduced by an additional 15% and their Cryo RES reduced by 30%.

description.0: After using Will to Purge, Danica gains 20% ATK SPD, and her Normal Attacks using the Storm Anchor grant her an additional 25 Will to Cleanse when they hit an opponent. The above effects can stack up to 3 times.
description.1: Danica gains 20% ATK after using Will to Protect.
description.2: Each of these effects lasts until its corresponding Attendant Form ends.

description.0: When party members trigger Superconduct, it will be changed to Stellar-Conduct, and party members' Base Stellar-Conduct DMG will be increased based on Danica's ATK: Every 100 ATK she has increases the Base Stellar-Conduct DMG by 0.7%. The maximum increase that can be gained this way is 14%.
description.1: Additionally, when Danica is within a Polestar Field, she will enter the Radiance: Stellar-Conduct state.

description.0: Increases your own party members' Movement SPD by 10% and reduces their Stamina consumption by 10% in extremely cold environments.
Danica regenerates 20 Elemental Energy when she uses the special Elemental Skill Will to Purge or Will to Protect. This effect can be triggered once every 14s.
description.1: Additionally, using the Elemental Burst Rite to Cleanse the World increases the enhancements for Maid: Cleaner form by 120% and the enhancements for Maid: Royal Guard form by 80%.

description.0: Danica also grants 7 stacks of Let Us Toast to all nearby party members when she uses her Elemental Skill Scouring Anchor.
description.1: Characters with this effect consume 1 stack of Let Us Toast when dealing Stellar-Conduct reaction DMG, increasing that DMG by an amount equal to 100% of Danica's ATK.
description.2: Additionally, Danica consumes all her stacks of Let Us Toast when she deals Stellar-Conduct reaction DMG in Maid: Cleaner form, increasing that DMG by an amount equal to 150% of her ATK.
description.3: Your own active character also gains 1 stack of Let Us Toast when nearby party members consume a combined total of 6 stacks of Let Us Toast. Using the Elemental Skill Scouring Anchor or the special Elemental Skill Will to Protect resets the number of Let Us Toast stacks held by all nearby party members.
